Heard learned counsel for the Petitioner, learned counsel for the State and learned counsel for the Informant.

2. The Petitioner is an accused in C.T. Special (POCSO) No.42 of 2023 pending in the Court of learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special under POCSO Act, Jajpur, arising out of Badachana P.S. Case No.93 of 2023, for commission of alleged offence under Sections 451/376(3)/380 of IPC and Section 4(2) of POCSO Act.

3. Learned counsel for the Petitioner, on instruction, submits that except the present BLAPL, no other bail application of the Petitioner is pending in any other Court, relating to the aforesaid P.S.
Case.
4.

Being aggrieved by the rejection of his application for bail U/s.439 Cr.P.C by the learned Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Jajpur by order dated 09.10.2023 in the aforementioned case, the present BLAPL has been filed.

entities.text: Additional District & Sessions Judge-cum-Special Judge (POCSO), Jajpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
5. It is submitted by the learned counsel that the Petitioner is in custody since 15.04.2023 and in the meanwhile as the victim and other witnesses have been examined, he may be released on bail.
6.
Learned counsel for the State as well as the informant opposes the prayer for bail relying on the Rama @ Rama Chandra Nayak vs State Of Odisha ....

1 statement of the victim, P.W.4.
7.
This Court perused the statements of the victim, P.W.4,one occurrence witness(P.W.8) and the medical examination report.
P.W.8 has not supported the prosecution.
8. Considering the materials on record, this Court directs the Petitioner to be released on bail on such terms to be fixed by the Court in seisin.
9. It is further directed that the petitioner shall not in way try to intimidate the informant and/or her family.
10. It shall be open to the informant and/or her family to seek variance of this order, in the event there is any threat perception.

11. It is directed to the Petitioner that he shall not leave the jurisdiction of the learned Court in seisin without its express permission and intimation to I.O.
12.
Accordingly, the BLAPL stands disposed of.
13. Urgent certified copy of this order be granted as per rule.

(V. NARASINGH)
